headline: Cardi told fans and journalists she’s officially working on her new album — and after her
body: Cardi told fans and journalists she’s officially working on her new album — and after her birthday in November, she’s stepping away from everything just to record. She repeated it twice: “I’m shifting myself away… just to record.” When the journalist asked if she was gonna make everyone wait eight years again, Cardi shut it down instantly: “NOPE… oh. Nope.” Fans say focused Cardi is the best Cardi What’s your take on this mom cardib.
